author: logangraham
text:
Plausibly the most exciting news in UK (and global) science: @ARIA_research , a true ARPA, legally exists as of today, has £££, and a world-class board and leadership team. @ilangur @matthewclifford:

"...For I dipt into the future, far as human eye could see..."

quoted.text: Really excellent board for ARIA - small + focused, with truly world class ppl. Includes Vaccine Task Force lead Kate Bingham, Scottish Nobel laureate David MacMillan, and Google X policy head Sarah Hunter (former no10 in Blair years).
